summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for surgical management of class III morbid obesity (BMI ~40) with comorbid obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP and gastroesophageal reflux. She underwent a laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass with intraoperative endoscopy and recovered without complications, initially requiring Dilaudid PCA for pain control before transitioning to oral Roxicet. An upper GI study confirmed no anastomotic leak or obstruction, allowing staged diet advancement to Stage III, which she tolerated well. Port sites remained dry, the JP drain was removed without difficulty, and she ambulated independently; she was discharged home with instructions to crush all pills, avoid NSAIDs, continue CPAP, remain on Stage III diet until surgical follow-up in 2 weeks, and take prescribed medications including Protonix, Actigall, and Colace with return precautions for concerning symptoms.
